task: PQR skin emergence and IVGQR continuum dissolution dynamics

results.regime: PQR Emergent / IVGQR Dissolved into Continuum

primary_papers: Speth et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 113, 082501 (2014)
evidence_boundaries.mechanistic_law: Establishes that the classical whole-nucleus quadrupole vibration breaks down in neutron-rich skin nuclei (58Ni -> 68Ni -> 78Ni): the development of a 0.26 fm neutron skin in 78Ni decouples valence neutrons from the core, pushing a new collective Pygmy Quadrupole Resonance (PQR) down to 11.2 MeV (carrying ~16% of the E2 EWSR), while low neutron binding (Sn = 5.4 MeV) immerses the IVGQR 25 MeV deep into the continuum, expanding its Landau damping width from 4.8 to >9.0 MeV and dissolving the coherent isovector quadrupole peak into a smooth continuum background.
